The Grain Dryer dries crops with heat and no FE. It only works while it's above 60°C, so it needs a heat source: a Firebox, a Geothermal Plant or a warm Heat Cell against its heat face (the back, by default). It takes 4 HU/t and 10 s per item.
| In | Out |
| Hop Cones | Dried Hops |
| Wheat | Dried Grain |
| Sorghum Stalks | Dried Sorghum |
Dried Grain and Dried Sorghum ferment in half the time, for the same Ethanol. Dried Hops go in the Fermenter's additive slot. Speed and Heat upgrades work.
